title: Placement
description: Which side of the mania stage the gameplay cluster floats on. It sits against that screen edge, a little above centre, clear of the stage, score and HP bar.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the cluster (gameplay) or the results strip horizontally, in 1080p pixels.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the cluster (gameplay) or the results strip vertically, in 1080p pixels.

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–1.6. The cluster still shrinks to fit if its region is narrower.

title: Stage column width
description: Your skin's mania ColumnWidth (osu! virtual px; default skin 30). Used with Column start to find the free space beside the stage.

title: Stage column start
description: Your skin's mania ColumnStart (osu!stable virtual px; default skin 136). osu!lazer centres the stage and ignores this.

title: Backing
description: none: floats on the game with a text shadow. scrim: adds a soft dark shade that fades out. panel: a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: Tints the brand mark with the current map's colour (map) or keeps 18-LAB amber. Early/late colours never change.

title: Histogram bins
description: Number of bins across the chart (the mania 100 window either side of 0 ms). Rounded up to an odd count so one bin sits on 0 ms; clamped to 9–61.

title: Per-column release
description: Shows each column's mean release error under the chart during gameplay. Needs ENABLE_MANIA_KEY_HIT_ERRORS = true in the vosu config; without it a one-line note names the setting.

title: Results strip
description: On the results screen, shows the final press/release split in the header band (osu! only shows press and release combined).

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag in the header.
